summary: Doceebo Inc., a Toronto-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting final results of its substantial issuer bid (a Canadian issuer tender offer), which was fully subscribed. The company will purchase for cancellation 99,332 common shares at US$25.00 per share, for aggregate consideration of US$2,483,300, representing roughly 0.4% of shares outstanding as of the July 20, 2026 announcement. Intercap Inc. tendered 13,351 shares and retains 15,900,000 shares, or about 63.7%. Payment is via TSX Trust Company. Watch the controlling holder's overhang and post-tender liquidity.
